rules.statement: A plaintiff who has satisfactorily proved uninterrupted possession of land for over ten years may be entitled to a declaratory decree even if the benefit of a specific prescription ordinance was not expressly claimed in the plaint.
rules.supporting_quote: "The plaintiff has satisfactorily proved that he and Salgado have since the Fiscal's sale in 1883 down to the time of the ouster in 1885 held uninterruptedly his share. I have some doubts as to whether we ought to do more than give plaintiff a merely possessory decree without dealing with the question of title. But my brothers are of opinion that we ought to put and end to this litigation by making a declaratory decree now, and I yield to their opinion."
